title: Who is the current Prime Minister of India?

messages.content: Who is the current Prime Minister of India?
The current Prime Minister of India is Narendra Modi. He was sworn in for his third term on June 9, 2024, following the 2024 Parliamentary elections.
When did he take office and which party does he belong to?
Narendra Modi took office for his current (third) term on June 9, 2024. He belongs to the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP).
Narendra Modi holds a Bachelor of Arts (BA) degree in Political Science from Gujarat University, which he completed in 1978.
